lines.en: How was the plane able to clear the mountains?
lines.zh: 飞机是如何能够越过山脉的？

lines.en: In 1929, three years after his flight over the North Pole,
successfully flew over the South Pole for the first time.
Though, at first, Byrd and his men were able to take a
lines.zh: 虽然起初，伯德和他的队员们能够拍摄到

lines.en: great many photographs of the mountains that lay below,
they soon ran into serious trouble.
lines.zh: 但他们很快就遇到了严重的麻烦。

lines.en: At one point, it seemed certain that their plane would crash.
lines.zh: 有一刻，他们的飞机似乎肯定会坠毁。

lines.en: It could only get over the mountains if it rose to 10, 000 feet.
lines.zh: 只有当飞机上升到10,000英尺时，才能越过山脉。

lines.en: Byrd at once ordered his men to throw out two heavy food sacks.
lines.zh: 伯德立即命令他的队员们扔掉两个沉重的食物袋。

lines.en: The plane was then able to rise and it cleared the mountains by 400 feet.
lines.zh: 飞机随后得以升高，并以400英尺的高度越过了山脉。

lines.en: Byrd now knew that he would be able to reach the South Pole which was 300 miles away,
lines.zh: 伯德现在知道他将能够抵达300英里外的南极，

lines.en: for there were no more mountains in sight.
lines.zh: 因为视线中没有更多的山脉了。

lines.en: The aircraft was able to fly over the endless white plains without difficulty.
lines.zh: 飞机能够毫不费力地飞越无尽的白色平原。
